title: New Lagos Rising Anew
author: Dominic Hartwell
blurb: Astrid Fairweather, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
